name: invitations-e2e
command: xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' env PUBLIC_PORT=4133 NEXT_INTERNAL_PORT=5133 CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium PW_NO_WEBSERVER=1 INVITATION_SCREENSHOTS=1 bunx playwright test tests/e2e/invitations.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --reporter=list

name: regression-e2e
command: PUBLIC_PORT=4133 NEXT_INTERNAL_PORT=5133 CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium PW_NO_WEBSERVER=1 bunx playwright test tests/e2e/boot.spec.ts tests/e2e/preflight.spec.ts tests/e2e/signal-server.spec.ts --project=chromium --reporter=list
